messages:
Maya: heads-up I'm opening a tiny PR to add a "quick Q&A" section to the Optimize toolkit page — aim is to consolidate the common docs/support back-and-forth about batching + kv-prefetch + quant profiles. draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/8710
Theo: Love it. Can the Q&A include a short scenario matrix: streaming endpoint vs non-streaming, recommended MaxBatchMs, and whether to enable per-request prefetch? folks copy the answers into tickets. :memo:
Maya: yes — planning a 3-row matrix and a short decision tree. will also add the exact config keys (Batching.MaxBatchMs, Batching.MaxBatchSize, prefetch.enabled).
Priya: Add one sample for "when tokens stall" showing how to check both metrics and headers (SSE vs chunked). People mistake SSE lag for server-side batching.
Maya: good point. I'll add this snippet to check SSE headers:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=rwd-3" | head -n 20
```
Theo: Also include a tiny JS client example that opts out of prefetch per-call (customers want route-level control):
```js
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', input, prefetch: { enabled: false } })
```
Priya: For the quant profiles section: please avoid vague language like "low-memory". Use exact profile ids (q4_0, q8-balanced, q8-highmem) and list expected memory change percentage vs float32 (approx). Ops asked for numbers to triage OOMs.
Maya: I'll add approximate memory multipliers and a note "measure on your target GPU". Also planning a short bench script invocation for reader copy-paste: `./perf/check.sh --model rwd-3 --quant q8-highmem`.
ops-bot: @Maya automated snippet-lint scheduled. Link-check will run on PR open.
Sam: tiny UX nit: Under "Recommended fallback" please present the steps in order: 1) set prefetch=false per-route 2) set MaxBatchMs=0 for streaming 3) switch quant profile 4) increase capacity. Customers follow that order to minimize cost first.
Maya: Good -- will reorder. ETA PR in 2h, pinging for quick review after link-check. Thanks! :rocket:
